g.text: Permutations: the state changes between neighboring results
For sorted input [1, 2, 3], used records INPUT INDICES, not output positions.
Repeated values: label occurrences 1a and 1b only to track their indices.
At path []: 1a is unused, so skip 1b as a sibling choice.
At path [1a]: 1a is used, so 1b may fill the next position.
